strengths: Specific, verifiable metrics throughout: 100→300+ users, tens of thousands of documents, Fortune-200 client, 3 junior engineers mentored
Strong company research: mentions Fastino's investors (Microsoft, Khosla Ventures), team pedigree (Google Research, Apple), and focus on small language models
Honest gap acknowledgment: directly addresses missing Kubernetes/Docker production experience and knowledge-graph extraction without being defensive
Relevant domain experience in regulated biopharma environment shows ability to work in high-stakes contexts
Good opening hook with the scaling story—feels like a real professional reflecting on their work
weaknesses: Cover letter uses section headings (## Opening, ## Role Alignment, etc.) which breaks the convention of flowing prose—this signals inexperience with professional correspondence
Missing two key skills from job requirements: Kubernetes and Docker orchestration have no presence in resume, creating ATS keyword gaps
Cover letter has a few slightly formulaic phrases that reduce authenticity: 'represents something I've been working toward', 'I'd welcome the chance to discuss'
The biopharma regulatory work is interesting but undersold—could emphasize the precision/compliance aspects more as differentiator
revision_suggestions: Remove all section headings from cover letter and rewrite as flowing paragraphs with natural transitions
Add a brief mention of containerization familiarity in resume—even if not production Kubernetes, any Docker exposure would help ATS matching
Replace formulaic closing ('I'd welcome the chance to discuss') with something more specific to Fastino's mission or a question that invites conversation
Consider expanding the biopharma regulatory work bullet to emphasize compliance, precision, and auditability—these matter for enterprise AI platforms
